## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Jaeger`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `jaeger-distributed-tracing`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Jaeger**.

## Step 2: Start Jaeger

1. <!-- manual: Run the Jaeger OpenTelemetry all-in-one image for development and testing: For production deployments with higher throughput, use the dedicated Jaeger collector and agent components. -->

## Step 3: View Traces

1. <!-- manual: Select your service from the Service dropdown. -->
2. Select **Find Traces**.
3. <!-- manual: Click a trace to view the span details. -->
